entities.title: Godot project
entities.summary: The game itself: Godot 4.7 with the Compatibility renderer, exported for the web by build.mjs and runnable on the desktop.
entities.purpose: Everything the player sees and does: menus, the briefing room, the match, and the message layer between browsers.
boundaries: No art or sound files: the world, agents, furniture and effects are built from primitives in code.
